result.brief: 提出 SemanTok 灵活视频分词器，用冻结 DINO 特征监督每个 token 前缀的语义重建，提升自回归视频生成的语义对齐与保真度。
result.reason: SemanTok is a flexible coarse-to-fine video tokenizer for autoregressive video generation and video world models, improving semantic alignment and generation fidelity with cheaper short token prefixes.
